# INDEX — graphql-expert

## What the source really is

**GQL** = `GraphQL-Learn-Official.pdf`: PDF capture of the **graphql.org/learn** page (metadata title: "Learn | GraphQL"), generated by a headless browser on **18/Aug/2026** (metadata). 6 pages, about 4 thousand characters, no images.

- **Nature:** lesson index + landing. It carries **lesson titles and one or two lines of description** for each. **No lesson was captured**: there is no schema, query or mutation syntax, no code, no diagram, no definition.
- **Version:** no GraphQL specification or library version is declared. [DATED] everything is relative to 18/Aug/2026 and to an index, not to the lessons' content.
- **Capture quality:** descriptions cut at the page break (Learn Lesson 1, pp. 1-2; File Uploads, pp. 2-3); lists truncated by "Show more" buttons; menu/footer text (p. 6) of no technical value; p. 5 is only FAQ categories and two links. No page is a 404.
- **Page convention:** PDF page (1-6). The source has no printed numbering; there is no map to provide.

## references/ files

## Labels

`[from source]` = read on the cited page (here "from the PDF"; use `[from source] (GQL p.N)`); `[inference]`; `[extrapolation]` = general knowledge outside the source; `[DATED]`; **NOT COVERED** = the source does not address it. The reference files are paraphrases; there is only short, rare literal quotation.
